info.name: Access to features matching a given query

params.name: request
params.description: The type of request being made.

params.name: service
params.description: The type of service being requested.

params.name: version
params.description: The type of service being requested.

params.name: typeNames
params.description: The Feature Type being requested.

params.name: bbox
params.description: A set of valid WFS BBOX coordinates, in the order <bottom-left y, bottom-left x, top-right y, top-right x> (Dependent on CRS)

params.name: filter
params.description: A valid OGC XML filter object

params.name: count
params.description: An integer stating the maximum number of features to be returned in a single response. In version 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 this is known as maxFeatures

params.name: maxFeatures
params.description: An integer stating the maximum number of features to be returned in a single response. In version 2.0.0 this is known as count

params.name: propertyName
params.description: A list of valid feature attribute names, for example, ChangeDate, TOID, PhysicalLevel

params.name: startIndex
params.description: An integer stating which result to start from, when returning a response

params.name: outputFormat
params.description: The format the response will be returned in. Default: XML.

params.name: resultType
params.description: Type of the results. Default: results.

params.name: srsName
params.description: Allows the user to reproject the selected features into another CRS. Default: EPSG:27700

items.docs: Access to features matching a given query
